description: Wiry lean Dominican man in his 60s: thick grey moustache, cheeky grin, worn light-tan flat cap, white ribbed tank under an open short-sleeved faded tan shirt, worn knee-length shorts, brown lace-up shoes. Toon style, matte colours.

rig.command: tripo anim rig <gen> --rig-type biped -p model=rig-v1.0 --out-format glb

retarget.command: tripo anim retarget <rig> --animation preset:biped:idle preset:biped:sit preset:biped:look_around --animate-in-place --out-format glb

raw.contents: Tripo retarget export (rig v1.0 + 3 baked clips) + hip-offset post-process, uncompressed

web.optimize_command: npx -y @gltf-transform/cli optimize <raw> assets/characters3d/manuel/manuel-web.glb --texture-size 1024 --texture-compress webp --simplify true --simplify-ratio 0.35 --compress meshopt
web.loader_note: needs a MeshoptDecoder + WebP-capable loader (three.js: GLTFLoader + MeshoptDecoder from three/examples/jsm/libs/meshopt_decoder.module.js); verified loading in headless Chrome/Edge

preview.contents: 1160x808 composite of two renders of manuel-web.glb (front + three-quarter), idle clip t=0.4s

measurements.height_evidence: raw glb: skinned mesh POSITION bbox y 0.0..1.0000 (mesh node world transform = identity); three.js skinned-pose bbox with the idle clip: y -0.007..1.001
measurements.facing_evidence: rest ankle->toe vectors: L_Foot->L_ToeBase (0.0350, -0.0039, -0.0143), R_Foot->R_ToeBase (0.0331, -0.0012, +0.0109); mean unit vector (0.996, -0.076, -0.050) => forward = +X (matches Tripo export_orientation default '+x'). Character-left = -Z (all L_* joints sit at -Z). Feet are splayed ~20 deg outward about +X.
measurements.scale_hint: multiply by 1.7 to get metres (approx. 1.7 m tall character)

post_processing.what: Restored the Hip joint's rest translation offset in all three animation clips (both raw and web files).
post_processing.why: Tripo's retarget output animates Hip.translation without the rest offset (rest = (0, 0, 0.47392) in the Hip's local frame, where local +Z maps to world +Y; animated keys were ~(0,0,0)). Loaded in three.js / any spec-compliant glTF viewer the whole character therefore sank 0.474 units below the origin: measured hipWorldY 0.000, skinnedPoseY -0.481..0.527.
post_processing.fix: Added (0, 0, 0.47392287850379944) to every Hip translation keyframe of each clip (369 + 173 + 375 keys). Every other joint hangs off the Hip, so this is a rigid vertical translation - the authored poses are preserved.
post_processing.verified: three.js render of the optimised web file: hipWorldY 0.474, skinnedPoseY -0.007..1.001, feet on the y=0 grid for idle and look_around; sit reads as a seated pose.
post_processing.caveat: The sit clip keeps the hip at standing height (feet ~0.17 above the ground), i.e. it is authored for a seat/stool, not the floor. If the game wants a floor-level sit, lower the character ~0.17 for that clip.
post_processing.revert: subtract (0, 0, 0.47392287850379944) from the Hip translation keys of each clip

visual_verdict: Close to the reference. Present and correct: tan flat cap with brim, thick grey moustache, grey brows, big expressive eyes, wiry lean build, long thin bare legs, white ribbed tank under an open short-sleeved faded-tan shirt (chest pocket), worn knee-length shorts, brown lace-up shoes, matte toon look. Differences: the 3D shading is a touch more PBR/realistic than the flat toon illustration, the face is slightly narrower and the cap brim reads flatter than the reference. No holes, no broken limbs, no missing parts; textures clean after the webp/1024 optimise.
known_limits: Clips were retargeted with --animate-in-place, so there is no root translation - the game must drive movement itself.
All three clips animate the same rig; only the three listed clips are in the file.
The raw 57 MB export is not what the browser should load - use manuel-web.glb (3.3 MB, meshopt + webp).
